parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the container cluster to query.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in a paged query.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end timestamp of the query.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type for the request and response messages. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start timestamp of the query.
